extracted.name: Mashed Yellow Squash
extracted.description: This is a bit different but it is excellent!! It is a great side dish or afternoon snack for those that love squash or have oodles of it popping up in their gardens!
instruction_lines: Slice and steam or boil squash until tender. Pour off any remaining water.
Mash the squash slightly. In a medium size pot place mashed squash, onion, butter, milk, salt and pepper. Mix well and heat over a medium flame. Serve warm.
